preconditions.description: The number of operations n must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= i - 1 for i in range(1, n + 1))
preconditions.description: For each operation i, the number of edges k must be between 0 and i-1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vj <= i - 1 for i in range(1, n + 1) for k in range(1, i) for vj in range(1, k + 1))
preconditions.description: Each vertex vj must be a valid vertex number between 1 and i-1 for each operation i.

postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the weights of all edges modulo 1000000007.
